value.title: Seat identity provenance, phase 1: route inventory and capability bootstrap (PRD 003 req-10, F88)
value.summary: The route inventory and its sensor, the capability bootstrap workshop, cost, and docs and states.

value.title: The route inventory and its sensor
value.success: harness/scripts/route-inventory.json classifies all 77 (method, path) pairs main serves (47 seat-authority, 29 machine-public, 1 job-token; 12 of them implicit HEAD). just route-inventory-check probes the router from Endpoint::ALL under every standard method and fails on a missing, stale, repeated or unclassified pair; it is a heavy harness checks stage and a self-check step, niced, with timeouts.

value.title: Workshop 001: capability bootstrap
value.success: workshops/001-capability-bootstrap.md compares options A, B and C against every question in AC2 and recommends C, with the route classes ordered for phase 2, send-as first.

value.title: Cost
value.success: No daemon runtime change: the sensor is a cfg(test) module run once per harness checks invocation. The workshop states the chosen design's per-request cost and that nothing launches per tick per seat.

value.title: Docs and states
value.success: docs/how/pij-rs-api.md gains a Seat authority section pointing at the inventory; docs/difficulties.md records F88 (D-221-1); the plan states phases 2 and later as follow-up waves.

tk-0001.assertion: route_inventory_tests: the repo inventory matches the probed routes, and a missing route, a stale entry, a duplicate, an unclassified or misclassified route, a job-token mismatch and a malformed file each fail; mutating the real JSON fails the repo test by name.

tk-0002.assertion: Security and reviewer verdicts, pass or pass-with-notes, pinned to the workshop's commit.

tk-0003.assertion: The only daemon source change is a #[cfg(test)] module declaration; no new launch site, loop, poll or timer.

tk-0004.assertion: just ddocs-check passes; CI on the exact head; reviewer, security and performance verdicts.
